## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +0.73%) while XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +5.47%); VXX falling (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -12.69%) BELOW TREND and credit signals showing stress (Credit Spread 1W: +0.82% | 1M: +0.63%) provide mixed confirmations.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -12.69%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress creeping higher: HYG (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND. Consumer pullback: XLY (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (Dollar) (1W: -0.46% | 1M: +1.18%) CORRECTION, TLT (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -0.46%) BELOW TREND — yields rising and curve flattening (Yield Curve ↓ falling).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/value showing relative strength: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +5.47%) and XLE RECOVERY (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -2.89%) while Tech lagging: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +0.73%). Style: Value/cyclicals leading over growth.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +1.32%). China recovering: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +5.86% | 1M: -3.05%). Europe showing relative strength: VGK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +1.02%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed but active: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +3.19%) and ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.26% | 1M: +10.45%), while ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +7.61%) shows selective rotation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals uneven: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -5.50%) while CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -2.65%) — industrial commodity tone weakening.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy resilient on the week: XLE RECOVERY (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -2.89%) while natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -0.60%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +5.47%). DIVERGENCE: MAJOR Divergence across tech complex (XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +0.73%), QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -3.39% | 1M: +1.02%), SOXX large 1W drawdown) — suppress strong directional bias.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor Financials and Energy exposure (XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +5.47%), XLE RECOVERY (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -2.89%)); reduce exposure to Tech (XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +0.73%), QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -3.39% | 1M: +1.02%)); monitor credit via HYG/LQD and TLT.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +5.47%) and Energy XLE RECOVERY (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -2.89%) if earnings/credit tone holds. BEARISH: Tech XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +0.73%) and Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -0.69%) if momentum continues lower.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil/Brent BNO RECOVERY (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -14.90%) on supply cues. BEARISH: Copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -2.65%) as industrial signals soften.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency marker), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY/TLT ~8.84 (stock vs bond regime), XLK/XLF ~3.30 (tech vs financials leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, mixed risk signals with VXX falling but credit stress showing signs of strain. Financials (XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +5.47%)), Energy (XLE RECOVERY (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -2.89%)) and Biotech (XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +26.78%)) showing strength; Tech (XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +0.73%)) is the key divergence to monitor alongside rising credit signals.
